name: install-memu
title_zh: 给任何 Agent 装上或卸下 memU 记忆插件
tagline_zh: 不管你是 Claude、GPT 还是本地脚本，一条命令识别宿主、打印专属接线图，把记录和注入两条缝都焊上——或干净。
tagline_en: No matter which agent you are, it detects your host, prints your exact wiring guide, and connects or disconnects.
desc_en: Install or uninstall memU for whatever agent you are — identify your host, print its packaged guide, and follow it to wire (or unwire) both seams (record and inject). Use when the user asks to install, set up, integrate, remove, or uninstall memU.
why_zh: 不猜宿主、不写死路径。它先自报家门再给图，按图施工，两条缝都接上才算完。卸载也走同一张图，不留半截线头。
why_en: No guessing your runtime. It introspects first, then hands you the exact map—both seams must be wired before it calls it done.
limit_zh: 只处理 memU 自身的安装/卸载，不碰其他插件或系统配置。需要你有终端执行权限；若宿主是封闭平台（如纯网页版）。
limit_en: Only installs/removes memU itself—no other plugins or system config. Requires shell access; on closed hosts (e.g., pure web UI) it can only print.
